SUMMARY: Fri 11/13 ~ Ride Around Chatfield  Reservoir/Opt.Lunch at Pub&Grub
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
Hello Ladies!
**E-Bike and Advanced Classic Bike Riders**
**Pace:** Approximately 15 mph, with occasional faster stretches
**Distance:** Approximately 28 miles

We'll meet at **9:30 AM at Pub and Grub**, with wheels rolling by **9:45 AM**. If you need a little extra time to get ready, please adjust your arrival time accordingly. We'll head south on the Platte River Trail toward Chatfield Dam and then enjoy a complete loop around beautiful Chatfield Reservoir. Along the way, we'll encounter a steep but very manageable climb to the top of the dam, which we'll ride from both the east and west sides as we make our loop. We'll also take a snack and restroom break about halfway around at a nice gazebo. When we finish, there's the option of enjoying lunch together at Pub and Grub!

**Bike Parking:** We should be able to lock our bikes just outside the patio fence, and possibly even inside the fenced patio area. That way, whether we're dining inside the restaurant or out on the patio, we'll be able to keep an eye on our bikes and feel comfortable knowing they're nearby!

**A Few Things to Know About the Trail**
The east side of the dam has about a mile of paved trail, followed by another mile of gravel. Riders on traditional road bikes with narrower tires may find this section a little more challenging, while the wider tires on most e-bikes should handle it more comfortably.
The good news is that the more worn, well-traveled portions of the trail are generally easier to ride on. There is also a short, somewhat gravelly downhill section coming off the trail. We'll simply take that slowly and use extra caution.
It's all very doable, and I think everyone will do just fine!

**A Couple of Safety Reminders**

* Please private message me your cell phone number if I don't already have it, and I'll send you mine in return. Don't forget! 😊
* Please make sure your emergency contact's name and cell phone number are clearly labeled on the inside of your helmet.

Thank you!

**A Few Courtesy and Safety Notes**

* As a courtesy to other riders, please keep your RSVP current.
* This is a participate-at-your-own-risk event. By signing up, you acknowledge that you are solely responsible for your own safety.

Please let me know if you have any questions.
**Looking forward to a fun ride with everyone! See you then!!**
\~ Vicky E.

SUMMARY: A Beautiful Ride to Golden - Peaks to Plains Trail - Lunch at Cafe 13
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
Hello Ladies!
**E-Bikers and Advanced Classical Bike Riders**
Let's meet at **Prospect Lake at 10:00 AM**, with wheels rolling by 10:15 AM!
We'll head to Golden and enjoy the beautiful **Peaks to Plains Trail** along Clear Creek. From Golden, we'll continue west along the scenic trail, passing the Clear Creek Trailhead before making our way to the Huntsman Trailhead. The final 1.5-mile section has officially opened just within the last few days, making this an especially exciting ride!
The scenery along this stretch is absolutely stunning, and I'm excited for everyone to experience it!

On our way back, we'll head to **Café 13 in Golden** for a delicious lunch. It's just a few bike-friendly blocks from the trail. They have a wonderful outdoor patio and several convenient options for parking our bikes. We can lock them up at a nearby bike rack or, if we prefer, keep them close by at the outdoor patio tables. Indoor dining is also available. And best of all, the food is fantastic! It's a great place to relax, enjoy a delicious meal, and visit together.
After lunch, we'll hop back on our bikes and enjoy the trail for our return ride.

**A Few Ride Details:**

* **Meeting Time:** 10:00 AM (departing at 10:15 AM)
* **Location:** Prospect Lake
* **Distance:** Approximately 25 miles
* **Pace:** Around 15 mph
* **Lunch:** Café 13 in Golden
*

**A Couple of Safety Reminders:**
Please send me your cell phone number, and I'll share mine with you so we can stay in touch in case plans change.
Also, please make sure your emergency contact's name and phone number are clearly written inside your helmet. Hopefully, we will never need it, but it's always good to be prepared!

It's going to be a beautiful ride with gorgeous scenery, great food, and even better company! I'm looking forward to a fun day with all of you!
**See you there!**
Vicky E.

SUMMARY: 12/10 Christmas Lunch🎄Gift Exchange🎁Best Costume Prize@Platte River Bar&Grill
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
🔔 🎄\*\*Happy Early Christmas to all members!\*\*🔔🎄
We have some exciting details regarding our upcoming holiday celebration! Join us for a festive Christmas lunch, a gift exchange, and a chance to win a prize for the best holiday attire. Whether you are a regular in this Meetup group, have only attended once, or are joining us for the very first time, \*\*everyone is welcome!\*\*It’s a wonderful opportunity to catch up with old friends and make new ones.
You are also welcome to bring a guest who might want to join our community in the future—just be sure to add them to your RSVP!
**RSVP Deadlines**

* **Capacity Limit:** We have a maximum capacity of **12 people**, so spots are first-come, first-served!
* *When: **Event is Dec. 10th so RSVPs will close on Wednesday noon, December 9th.***
* **Why:** We must submit our final head count to the Platte River Grill the day before our event so they can prepare our seating. Please ensure your RSVP is accurate.

🎁 **Gift Exchange Details**

* **The Rules:** This year, there is no stealing! You will pick a number from a bowl and receive the gift that matches your number (starting with number one and moving down the line).
* **What to bring:** Please bring a purchased, wrapped, and thoughtful gift valued between **$10 and $20**.
* **The Theme:** Bring something fun or useful that anyone would enjoy. **This is not** **a White Elephant exchange**—no joke, random or gag gifts, please! Just something nice to put a smile on someone's face.
*

🎅 **Christmas Attire Contest**

Dress in your favorite festive holiday gear! Be as creative as you like, or keep it simple with a classic Santa hat. Everyone will vote on the best outfit, and the winner will take home a **$25 Platte River Bar & Grill gift card!**
ℹ️ **Next Steps & Questions**

* Please **private message me your cell number** if I don't already have it, and I will text you mine.
* Feel free to message me directly if you have any questions!

Don't forget your festive attire and your wrapped gift. We can't wait to celebrate the season with you all.

See you there!
Merry Christmas to all🎄!

Vicky E.

SUMMARY: Want to sell, buy, ask questions  about any type of services, etc. Site.
DESCRIPTION:
WOMEN'S FUN BIKING/E-BIKING, WALKING & MORE!!
Hello Bikers,

This is not a ride but a useful source by members to ask other members info they might need about anything on biking or about anything else.

**(Do not pay attention to the date, I just have it on there so that the post stays up. So this post is ongoing.)**

These are some example of the different types of question that you could ask if you needed help with something or information (give or get):

Does anyone have a bike to buy or sell?
Does anyone have a (fill in the blank) they want to sell or buy?
Do you know a good financial planner?
Does anyone know how to fix such and such on a bike?
Does anyone know the best product to clean your white handle bar wraps with?
Do you know of any good baby sitters?
Does anyone want to go to a certain concert in the park?
Does anyone know how to work a Garmin bike computer?
Does anyone want to go on a particular ride?
Does the trail to Downtown still have detours?
Or anything else.

So questions might be anything and everything to or from our brilliant, informative, and pretty cool biking members.

So just type any questions on the comment section.

I hope this will be helpful!!

Vicky E.
